Nexis UX Modernization — Prototype Review

Review each page below and reply in chat, one page at a time: approve, revise (say what's wrong), or defer. Nothing is implemented until a page is approved — see the footer for the full approval policy.

Known capture artifact: the harness-generated "before" screenshots for most pages show a stale sidebar highlight that incorrectly remains on "Dashboard" (the screenshot harness switches pages programmatically rather than via a real sidebar click — see CAPTURE_NOTES.md gotcha #5). The prototypes ("after" renders) deliberately show the correct sidebar highlight for each page. This is expected and not a regression to flag.
